Complaint filed against 'Ramayan' makers over alleged glorification of Ravan

A complaint has been filed against the makers of the film 'Ramayan' for allegedly glorifying Ravan and portraying Ram and Lakshman as cowards. Separately, a VFX artist has accused Namit Malhotra's company, involved in the film's production, of not increasing salary for four years and terminating employment. The film 'Ramayan' is reportedly performing well at the box office.
